_comment: Manual list of equivalent contract pairs to compare across platforms. Add one entry per pair you want the scanner to track. Fill in real tickers/slugs before the workflow will produce real data — see README.md 'Adding a market pair'.

_example_entry_fields.id: unique slug used in the log/history, keep stable once you start logging a pair
_example_entry_fields.label: human-readable name shown on the dashboard
_example_entry_fields.expiration: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of contract expiration/settlement
_example_entry_fields.settlement_note: free text - what index/source and timestamp both platforms settle to. Leave exact wording here so you can eyeball whether it still looks like a true match
_example_entry_fields.assume_locked: true if you've verified both contracts settle to the identical underlying index and identical settlement timestamp. false (or omit) makes the scanner tag any opportunity found here as basis_risk instead of locked, regardless of price

kalshi.ticker: the Kalshi market ticker, e.g. KXBTCD-26DEC31-T100000
kalshi.buy_side: yes or no - which side you'd buy on Kalshi to form the hedge with the Polymarket leg below

polymarket.slug: the Polymarket US market slug, e.g. btc-100k-2026
polymarket.buy_side: yes or no - which side you'd buy on Polymarket to form the complementary hedge

pairs.label: BTC ≥ $100k at 2026 year-end
pairs.settlement_note: REPLACE ME: confirm both platforms settle to the same index (e.g. both use a specific exchange BTC/USD reference rate) and the same settlement instant before setting assume_locked to true.
